name: What questions should you ask before hiring a tub-to-shower conversion contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners ask a contractor before hiring them for a tub-to-shower conversion in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should homeowners ask a contractor before hiring them for a tub-to-shower conversion in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor, homeowners should get clear answers about scope, materials, schedule, and accountability. Important questions include whether the contractor will handle permits, what waterproofing system they use, whether the drain or plumbing may need changes, how they manage hidden damage, and what warranty covers labor and materials. It is also smart to ask who will be on site, how dust and debris will be controlled, and whether the quote includes glass, trim, and final sealing. In Los Angeles-area remodels, older homes often reveal unexpected conditions, so the change-order process matters a lot. A strong contractor should explain what is included in the base price and what could add cost later. Homeowners should compare more than just the bottom line and look for experience with bathrooms, not only general construction. Clear communication at the start usually prevents the biggest frustrations later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about licensing, insurance, permit handling, waterproofing methods, drain work, timeline, warranty, cleanup, and what is included in the estimate. You should also ask who will handle inspections and what happens if hidden damage is found after demolition.
